facts.fact: The PDEX page, from NOSi, describes a live platform on which data owners publish their data as APIs, and names the civil identification system, the NhaCard platform and the national health system, and the Treasury DUC system as integrating through it; the API catalogue is stated as still to come.

The PDEX page says communication between the NhaCard platform and the national health system runs through PDEX, sharing data for social and medical benefits; it gives no count of health systems and no date.
The PDEX page says all integrations of the Consular Portal with the civil identification system run through PDEX, giving access to citizens' data; it does not say the portal verifies people.
The PDEX page says public and private entities already use the citizen data validation APIs on PDEX in their digital processes; it names no entity and gives no count.
facts.system: Citizen and company data validation APIs

systems.system: Citizen and company data validation APIs

CPV.note: The page carries no date; as_of is the published year, inferred.
